scope: Real CLI/Unix IPC/TCP/TLS and virtual protocol flows on freshly built frozen combined binaries. Discovery disabled by the runner; dedicated discovery proof remains separate.

scenario_results.requirement: Held Shift crosses once, releases once without recovery; receiver alone transforms wheel.
Client closes an unsupported major without sending EICV and exposes a plain protocol error.
Lost input repeats report an error without dropping peers; a lost up leaves only that peer and flushes ups/COUT before FIN.
Restart while already connected opens a real replacement connection for either role, with one adopted peer.
No input sent after trust.revoke replies reaches the sink; held input is released and the peer needs approval again.
Client caps its hello at 1.8, accepts mixed-case future server, sends no options or spontaneous heartbeat, and accepts sequence-zero push.
A raw peer sees ordinary DKDN, matching release ups and COUT before FIN on heartbeat death.
An occupied replacement port preserves exact TOML, live config, and an existing connection.
A remote payload stays available to a late peer even when the server cannot read its pasteboard back.
A real stopped reader fills the bounded Bulk queue; transfer abort is visible while IPC stays responsive.
SIGKILL of an approval holding the real trust-file lock releases it; a second CLI approval saves the pin.
A real atomic-save failure rolls back session-only and transport config without closing the old peer.
Server connected state clears old errors; TLS status distinguishes an unverified client from a verified server pin.
Synergy's core port is preserved in the imported client endpoint; the imported daemon connects and survives restart.
A valid server import may replace the db wire names with authoritative classic screens and a final core INI identity.
A real config patch accepts 64 MiB and rejects 64 MiB plus one byte without changing saved or live settings.
Restart after disconnect enables the real virtual capture and clipboard workers as well as reconnecting the transport.

limits: Thirty Docker cases explicitly excluded; no Docker started.
Virtual backend only; no native input/clipboard or live sharing exercised.
Dedicated final startup evidence audit and native Windows revised-startup acceptance remain open.
No throughput, latency speedup, CPU, native performance or long-soak claim. Equal binary size does not prove equal runtime resource use.
Stopped IPC/Synergy3 work remains separate and unaccepted; security/provenance, migration, whole-cache/expiry/query/byte, slow DNS and distribution gates remain open.
typescript_validation: Not applicable: Rust package build and real existing CLI E2E; no TypeScript package change.
